name: Foldsquare for WooCommerce
author: nowinstore

sections.description:
🚀 Beta — 50% OFF your first subscription period with code ENJOYTHEBETA

Foldsquare for WooCommerce lets you connect your online store to the Foldsquare catalog builder platform. Once connected, your WooCommerce products are automatically synced to Foldsquare, where you can design and publish professional catalogs, brochures, and lookbooks.

Features:

  • One-click connection to Foldsquare
  • Automatic product data sync via WooCommerce REST API
  • Secure API key management with easy revocation
  • No coding required

How it works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce > Foldsquare
  3. Click “Connect to Foldsquare”
  4. Your products are now available in the Foldsquare catalog builder

External Service:

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to Foldsquare, an external catalog builder service operated by Foldsquare Inc. When you click “Connect to Foldsquare”, the plugin:

  • Generates WooCommerce REST API keys (read-only access to products and categories)
  • Sends your store URL and API credentials to https://foldsquare.nowinstore.com over HTTPS
  • Redirects you to Foldsquare to complete the connection

When you disconnect, the plugin notifies Foldsquare at https://foldsquare.nowinstore.com/api/v1/auth/oauth/woocommerce/disconnect to revoke the connection on their end.

By using this plugin, you agree to the Foldsquare Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Foldsquare for WooCommerce is currently in Beta! Take advantage of this early access period and get 50% OFF your first period of subscription using the discount code ENJOYTHEBETA at checkout.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the foldsquare-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Foldsquare to connect your store.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Foldsquare account?

Yes. You need a Foldsquare account to use this plugin. Visit foldsquare.nowinstore.com to sign up.

What permissions does Foldsquare need?

The plugin creates WooCommerce REST API keys with read-only access so Foldsquare can read your product data and categories.

Can I disconnect my store?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce > Foldsquare and click “Disconnect”. This revokes the API keys and removes the connection.

Is my data secure?

API keys are transmitted over HTTPS and stored securely. You can revoke access at any time from the plugin settings page.
